title: The Mongoose Rotten Tomatoes score? Above 45
rules: If The Mongoose has a Tomatometer score of above 45 on Nov 2, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
The "Fresh!" and "Certified Fresh!" subtitles are meant for illustrative purposes only. The Tomatometer score must be above the strike value to resolve as YES (for example, a score of 75 would resolve "Above 75" as No.) The market will be determined the Monday after wide release at 10:00 AM ET.

This market and these products have not been endorsed by Rotten Tomatoes. Any references to Rotten Tomatoes or any associated marks are descriptive only and do not indicate an endorsement of this product or any affiliation between Rotten Tomatoes and Kalshi.

blind.reasoning: The Mongoose is a Samuel Goldwyn-distributed Liam Neeson action thriller directed by Mark Vanselow. Most comparable recent Neeson action films scored below 45% on Rotten Tomatoes (about 3 in 10 cleared it). The trailer drew mockery, and the Rotten Tomatoes page showed 0 reviews just before the October 30 release, suggesting a late embargo. That points to a score at or below 45.
blind.falsifier: Early critic reviews come in mostly positive, putting the Tomatometer at 50% or higher with 20+ reviews by Nov 2.

final.reasoning: The market's 0.285 is close to my estimate, so I nudged up slightly. The roughly 3-in-10 rate at which comparable Neeson action films clear 45%, plus the 0-review page just before opening and the mocked trailer, still keep me below the market. The edge is modest.
